[Benzinga news, 2026-10-24T02:01:53Z, by staff] Moderna and Merck Release Phase 3 Data for Cancer Vaccine Candidate Intismeran Autogene
Moderna and Merck released Phase 3 trial results for their investigational mRNA cancer vaccine, intismeran autogene, following an embargo breach.
Moderna and Merck released topline results from the Phase 3 INTerpath-001 trial evaluating intismeran autogene, an investigational individualized mRNA cancer therapy, in combination with KEYTRUDA for patients with resected stage IIB-IV melanoma. The data showed that the combination therapy reduced the risk of cancer recurrence or death by 42% compared to KEYTRUDA alone after approximately two years. The results were released early due to an embargo breach by the European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO). While the clinical data indicates a meaningful advance, the unexpected release led to significant volatility in Moderna's stock price.
